name: finora
description: Finora monorepo — ERP panel, corporate site and the .NET backend behind them
//: apps/land-web is deliberately NOT a workspace. It is React 19 + Next 15 while apps/erp-panel is React 18 + AntD 5; sharing one hoisted node_modules puts `next` beside React 18 and the app's own modules beside React 19 — two Reacts in one process. It keeps its own lockfile and install; the root scripts below drive it with --prefix.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:land
scripts.//lint: land-web is excluded: it has no ESLint configured (see its next.config.mjs, which sets eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds) and `next lint` prompts interactively. Add it there first, then add it here.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/land-web run typecheck
